landing.heroSubtitle: Book intercity bus tickets, choose your seat and follow your bus live on the map — across Bangladesh.
landing.searchComing: Online search & booking open in Phase 2. Live tracking, fleet operations and counter booking are already running.
landing.why1Desc: See exactly where your bus is and when it arrives — updated every few seconds.
landing.why2Desc: Pick your preferred seat from the live seat map at any branch, and soon online.
landing.why3Desc: Serving passengers across Bangladesh with a modern, well-maintained fleet.
landing.why4Desc: Trained crews, supervised trips and 24/7 operations monitoring on every route.
landing.safetyDesc: Every Star Line trip is monitored from our operations center. Trips have assigned drivers, supervisors and helpers, and every bus shares its live location.
landing.faq1Q: How do I book a ticket?
landing.faq1A: Today you can book at any Star Line branch counter. Online booking with seat selection launches in the next phase.
landing.faq2A: Yes — passengers with a booking can follow their bus live from their dashboard once the trip starts.
landing.faq3Q: How do I sign in as a passenger?
landing.faq3A: Use your +880 mobile number. We send a one-time code — no password needed.
landing.footerTagline: A modern transport platform for Bangladesh.
